summary: The board-design project (the board state layer, then the board orchestration design and its M1-M3 implementation) on its own board. lead-a held the orchestrator seat from 2026-09-30. On 2026-10-11 the same Lead continued in a new Claude session after context compaction (lead-b took the seat), and on 2026-10-12 in a branched session (lead-c). The thread history records both as seat replacements with a note; the board models each as an owner grant relayed by the incoming session, then role_replace_lead. Before the first replacement lead-a settled the M1 handback and answered the lease owner question; a protocol-types handback made just before the replacement stayed pending through both replacements and was settled by lead-c, together with M3.6 and M2.4 handbacks. It stops with M1 shipped, M2 and M3 in progress, nothing owed to the lead, and one owner item open: the Cloudflare staging account and deploy token.

args.text: Owner decisions, board structure: keep the levels and rename two (project -> workspace, topic -> project; a board gets kind initiative or area; a thread is conversation only). New entities: milestone, task (with subtask) and ADR; logs live in their own store and are linked. Tasks change status only through a recorded move, dependsOn forms a DAG with cycles rejected, subtasks go one level deep, and a task carries a typed PR link plus links[]. A milestone is a thin delivery checkpoint whose order and PR stack derive from the task DAG.

args.text: Owner decision: project leases (replaces the A/B/C question). 4-hour leases renewed every 15 minutes off the hot path. Before expiry, normal writes. After expiry with no holder change, new board writes are refused with leaseExpired, that project's wakes and schedules pause, reads keep working, and all of it resumes on renewal. No automatic release on shutdown and no automatic forced takeover: every holder change is an explicit admin or owner request; a clean move drains and hands over with nothing lost; a takeover fences first, then grants, and voids the unpushed tail with a warning. Always push in pieces (G13). Move and takeover go through a separate admin endpoint with separate credentials; machine credentials only renew, push and release. The owner chose refusal after expiry over the Lead's recommendation.

args.text: Owner decisions U40-U43 (2026-10-11): workstreams, not milestones, each carried by an implementer and verifier pair, with none by default; tasks and subtasks stay lightweight. A workspace holds ADRs and a project holds a decision register. The work trail is part of the board, separate from threads. A task has a title, body, status, blockedBy and relatedTo; duplicate and replace are actions. Spec 1 reworked accordingly; the Sol spec review's 2 blockers and 9 major findings are fixed. Supersedes the milestone and task-gate parts of the 2026-10-02 structure decision.
